agent_position: the change ships the scenarios and procedures, and qualification becomes a record made on each release candidate, the runbook's rule that every observation is made again on a new candidate applying to each release
owner_disposition: per release candidate, but a real-host run is owed again only when a change touches the Ansible layer or how an adapter executes it, and not otherwise; the question for any real-hardware test is whether anything since the last release changes what it would verify, so a release that touches neither rests on the earlier release's record
summary: 2026-11-26 rewrite: qualification is per release, and a real-host run is owed only when the Ansible layer or adapter execution changed (D1)
